sign_up_offers.title: SingSaver Card + Banking Bundle Offer
sign_up_offers.terms:
This promotion runs from 9 September 2026 to 30 September 2026.
Eligible applicants must not hold an existing Citi credit card, or have closed one within the past 12 months from card account opening date.
To qualify for the S$500 Cash reward, applicants must:
Apply for a participating Citi credit card via SingSaver;
Make a minimum spend of S$500 within 30 days of card approval; and
Hold a valid Citi banking account (existing or newly opened) by the end of the month following card approval.
The S$500 Cash reward replaces the standard SingSaver exclusive reward for your card—you receive one or the other, not the both. The S$500 Cash amount is the same regardless of which card you apply for.
Participating Citi banking account types are:
Existing Citi banking relationship includes 
Citigold
, 
Citigold Private Client
, 
Citi Plus
, 
Citi Priority
, 
Citibanking
New Citi banking relationship is applicable for 
Citigold
, 
Citigold Private Client
, 
Citi Plus
New banking customers who open a Citigold account through SingSaver may qualify for an additional SingSaver Exclusive welcome gift (worth up to S$1,500 Cash or Apple iPhone 17)—this is a separate offer from the credit card reward (additional T&Cs apply).
In case you choose the S$500 cash reward option and there is no banking relationship by the last day of the following month from your card application date but you meet the criteria for the credit card only reward, you will get the default cash reward available for your chosen card on application date.
Terms and Conditions
 apply.
